prompt: Blue brings home the biggest toy box on the street
title: Biggest Toy Box
irony: Blue hauls home the biggest toy box to hold the fun, but it eats all the room to play, so the kids empty it and she climbs in to play.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Blue wheels a tower-high toy box down the sunny street while Green and Navy stare.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green names each toy fact and wants the whole street tidy inside the giant toy box.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: The giant toy box wedges tight in the big-house gate and blocks the whole street.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street crowd circles the giant toy box and chants what fits inside.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Black dares Jade to fill the toy box first, and toys spill across the street.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Green, Jade and Black climb inside to sort toys and get stuck upside down laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crowd tugs the stuck toy box together and chants the hook even louder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue sits on the big-house step and admits she buys big surprises instead of playtime.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue tips the giant toy box on its side as a tunnel while Green checks it is safe.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The street sings together while Blue climbs inside the empty toy box to play.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The street shares the empty toy box tunnel while Blue plays inside with the kids.
